description: This file defines the ExcludedModulesEventSubscriber class, which implements an event subscriber to prevent certain modules from being exported in Drupal configuration. It manages the inclusion/exclusion of modules during config import/export processes, utilizing dependency management and storage interfaces.

classes.name: ExcludedModulesEventSubscriber
classes.description: Final class implementing an event subscriber to manage excluded modules during configuration import/export in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing storage, settings, and config manager dependencies.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events and corresponding callback methods for import and export transformations.

methods.name: onConfigTransformImport
methods.description: Handles configuration import transformation, ensuring excluded modules are preserved in storage.

methods.name: onConfigTransformExport
methods.description: Handles configuration export transformation, removing excluded modules from exported config.

methods.name: getExcludedModules
methods.description: Retrieves the list of modules marked as excluded from Drupal settings.

methods.name: getDependentConfigNames
methods.description: Finds all configuration names dependent on the excluded modules.
